items.definition:
crazy or eccentric; silly
He came up with a rather loopy idea for the project.

Relating to a number indicating position in a series.
"First, " "second, " and "third" are ordinal numbers.

Not officially announced or acknowledged.
They had an undeclared war going on.

Not feeling or showing sympathy.
The doctor was unsympathetic to her complaints.

Amusingly unconventional and eccentric.
The comedian's zany antics made everyone laugh.

friendly, good-natured, or easy to talk to
He was an affable host, making everyone feel welcome.

round and fat; bulging
The onion had a bulbous shape.

having the power to cure
The plant is believed to have strong curative properties.

easy and comfortable
He got a cushy job right after graduation.

tasting or smelling of hops
This IPA has a very distinct hoppy flavor.

not expressing genuine feelings
Her apology felt insincere and forced.

between cities
They took an intercity bus to travel across the country.

not involving or using words or speech
Her nonverbal cues indicated her discomfort.

Excessively protective
Her parents were very overprotective, rarely letting her go out alone.

relating to saliva
The salivary glands produce saliva.

short and fat
The tubby cat struggled to jump onto the sofa.

too expensive to be afforded
Housing in the city has become unaffordable for many residents.

(in sports) not selected in a draft
He was an undrafted player who went on to have a successful career.

impossible to reach
The top shelf was unreachable for the child.

not sealed or closed
The envelope arrived unsealed.

Worth collecting; able to be collected.
Vintage comic books are often highly collectible.

resembling or consisting of a marsh; boggy
We had to cross a marshy area to reach the lake.

able to be used or operated
The machine is now fully operable after the repairs.

relating to the period after childbirth
She received excellent postnatal care after the baby was born.

determined in advance
The software uses a set of predefined rules.

able to be expressed or measured as a quantity
We need to set quantifiable goals for the project.

Below an average or acceptable level.
His performance was subpar compared to his usual standards.

extremely light in weight
He bought an ultralight tent for his backpacking trip.

not willing to work with others or be helpful
The witness was uncooperative with the police investigation.

not valued or recognized enough
Many artists feel their work is underappreciated during their lifetime.

lacking in discipline or control
The undisciplined student often disrupted the class.

turned upward
He looked at the sky with an upturned face.

having no apparent weight
Astronauts experience a weightless sensation in space.

confined to bed by illness or infirmity
After the accident, he was bedridden for several weeks.

deliberately impassive or expressionless
He delivered the joke with a deadpan expression.

wet with dew
The grass was dewy in the early morning.

existing or conducted between colleges
The university hosts many intercollegiate sports events.

dependent on each other
All parts of the ecosystem are interdependent.

(of data compression) without any loss of information
FLAC is a lossless audio format.

not involving or intended for commerce
The station broadcasts noncommercial educational programming.

existing before a war
The house retained many of its original prewar features.

harsh and grating
After shouting all night, his voice was raspy.

stylish and attractive
She bought a snazzy new car.

covered with or having spines or thorns
Be careful; that plant has spiny leaves.

certain to succeed
His plan was a surefire way to win the competition.

(of a text) not cut or shortened; complete
She bought the unabridged version of the classic novel.

not meriting reward or special treatment
He felt undeserving of all the praise he received.

(especially of a person) untidy or disheveled
His unkempt hair suggested he had just woken up.

relatively expensive and of high quality
They decided to open an upmarket restaurant in the city center.

Relating to asthma
The asthmatic patient used an inhaler to help with breathing.

denoting the alphabet used for writing Russian and other Slavic languages
Many Eastern European languages use the Cyrillic alphabet.

making a statement or declaration
A declarative sentence states a fact or opinion.

tending to show feelings, especially openly
She was very demonstrative with her affection.

small and insignificant
They lived in a dinky little apartment.

Relating to or characteristic of elves.
She had an ethereal, almost elven beauty.

Full of or covered with a mass of small bubbles.
She poured the frothy milk into her coffee.

not suitable for eating
The berries were inedible, so we couldn't eat them.

relating to or experiencing menopause
Many women experience hot flashes during the menopausal transition.

composed of or involving members of various races
The city is known for its diverse and multiracial population.

relating to Nubia or its people
The Nubian pyramids are smaller and steeper than Egyptian ones.

Casual; without prior thought or preparation.
His offhand remark surprised everyone.

Feeling or showing panic.
She felt panicky when she realized she had lost her keys.

Engaged in deep or serious thought.
She looked pensive, staring out the window.

Relating to or characteristic of a student or graduate of an expensive preparatory school.
He wore a preppy outfit with a polo shirt and khakis.
